title: Cross-Task Generalization Between Understanding and Generation in Unified Vision-Language Models: A Controlled Study
abstract: arXiv:2505.23043v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) aim to support both visual understanding and generation within a single framework, but it remains unclear when mixed training benefits both capabilities and when it introduces conflicts. This paper presents a controlled empirical study of cross-task generalization between understanding and generation in unified VLMs. We construct two controllable image-text benchmarks, SmartWatch and modified CelebA, with paired VQA, captioning, and text-to-image generation tasks, and evaluate multiple LLM-based unified architectures built from SigLIP and VQ-VAE visual spaces. Our experiments show that mixed understanding-generation training can improve both tasks over task-specific training, but the benefit depends strongly on the relation between vision input and output spaces. translated_title: 统一视觉语言模型中理解与生成之间的跨任务泛化：一项受控研究
translated_abstract: 统一视觉语言模型（VLMs）旨在在单一框架内同时支持视觉理解与视觉生成，但目前尚不清楚混合训练何时能让两种能力同时受益，何时又会引入冲突。本文对统一视觉语言模型中理解与生成之间的跨任务泛化进行了一项受控实证研究。我们构建了两个可控的图像-文本基准 SmartWatch 和改进版 CelebA，包含配对的视觉问答（VQA）、图像描述（captioning）和文生图任务，并评估了基于 SigLIP 和 VQ-VAE 视觉空间构建的多种基于大语言模型的统一架构。我们的实验表明，理解与生成的混合训练在两项任务上都可以优于任务专属训练，但这一收益在很大程度上取决于视觉输入空间与输出空间之间的关系。视觉空间对齐更好的统一模型表现出更强的跨任务迁移能力，而视觉空间中可逆的仿射失真……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 统一视觉语言模型中理解与生成混合训练的收益取决于视觉输入与输出空间的匹配程度——视觉空间对齐越好，跨任务迁移效果越强。
en_tdlr: In unified vision-language models, the benefit of mixed understanding-generation training strongly depends on how well the visual input and output spaces are aligned, with better-aligned visual spaces yielding stronger cross-task transfer.
